name: Screenshot & Annotation Utilities
shortDesc: Region capture, instant screenshot markup, arrows, blurring, and clipboard copying.
detailedDesc: Replaces heavy tools with blazing-fast region select + instant annotation markup.

phase.title: Desktop QoL & Ricing Utilities
phase.description: The fine-grained ricing details: clipboard managers, color pickers, screenshot annotation, polkit, portals, and fonts.

packages.name: satty + grim + slurp (Recommended)
packages.description: Modern screenshot annotation tool built with GTK4 and libadwaita. grim captures pixels, slurp selects screen area, satty provides instant arrows, text, and blur markup.
pros: Quick arrows, rectangles, text, and pixelation blur
cons: Requires grim and slurp installed as capture backends

packages.name: swappy
packages.description: The classic Wayland snapshot editing tool. Very lightweight and responsive.
cons: Slightly dated UI compared to Satty

packages.name: hyprshot
packages.description: Hyprland-specific CLI utility that easily captures active windows, monitors, or regions with zero configuration.

packages.name: Flameshot
packages.description: Powerful and versatile screenshot software with integrated annotation and cloud upload.
cons: Requires XDG desktop portal under Wayland for proper area selection
